description: Checkout button does nothing on my phone. I put my card in and tapped Pay now three times. No error, no spinner, nothing. Did it on my laptop instead and it worked.
title: Pay now does nothing on phones: the postcode check fails silently
summary: On a phone, tapping Pay now runs the checkout handler, but it stops before sending anything because the postcode is empty, and the postcode field is hidden on small screens. Laptops show the field, so checkout works there.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/18.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

stage2_analysis.title: Pay now does nothing on phones: the postcode check fails silently
stage2_analysis.summary: On a phone, tapping Pay now runs the checkout handler, but it stops before sending anything because the postcode is empty, and the postcode field is hidden on small screens. Laptops show the field, so checkout works there.
stage2_analysis.rootCause: Three taps on Pay now were recorded, but no request to /api/checkout followed and nothing was logged, so the handler returns early. In src/components/CheckoutForm.tsx, handlePay returns when address.postcode is empty without showing an error, and the postcode input has the class "hidden sm:block", so on screens narrower than 640px it is never shown and can never be filled in. On a laptop the field is visible, which is why checkout works there.
stage2_analysis.suggestedFix: In src/components/CheckoutForm.tsx, remove "hidden" from the postcode input so it shows at every width, and replace the silent return in handlePay with a visible error next to the field. Add a test that renders the form at a 390px-wide viewport and submits it.
reproductionSteps: Open /checkout on a phone, or in a window 390px wide
Fill in the card number and expiry
Tap Pay now: nothing happens and no request is sent
Repeat on a laptop: checkout goes through

fix_packet:
# Fix this Mushi report: sample-checkout-pay-now

## Relevant code
### `src/components/CheckoutForm.tsx`
```
async function handlePay(e: React.FormEvent) {
  e.preventDefault()
  if (!address.postcode) return
  setPaying(true)
  await startCheckout({ cart, card, address })
}

<input
  name="postcode"
  className="hidden sm:block"
  value={address.postcode}
  onChange={(e) => setAddress({ ...address, postcode: e.target.value })}
/>
```

lines.note: Stops checkout without telling the user why.
Hides the postcode field on screens narrower than 640px.
